from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,hashlib,json,tarfile,base64
repo=Path('/workspace/goldbach-formalization');commit='07826355aedef5a01e76c36ad304bc6b115f3c2b'
label='next8-07-14';start=7;end=15
subprocess.run(['git','fetch','--no-tags','origin','work/p2-6-source-closure-20261125'],cwd=repo,check=True)
b=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',commit+':docs/verification/20261125-p26/archive-v4/verify/run_archive_v4_inputs.py'],cwd=repo)
assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='c7d7a43bd0b4ebc52f6d884a4b83cc82de531157dffa435ee5234bfb15a02c75'
mb=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',commit+':docs/verification/20261125-p26/archive-v4/verify/SOURCE_TARGETS.json'],cwd=repo)
assert hashlib.sha256(mb).hexdigest()=='29819ebed6b1a1ef036fd49f86db4e546cca74d93a73aa30f69d858908131f43'
all_modules=json.loads(mb)['owners'];modules=all_modules[start:end]
assert len(modules)==8 and all('ArchiveCore' not in m for m in modules)
d=Path('/workspace/p26-verify-20261125');p=d/'run_archive_v4_inputs_v1.py'
assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and p.read_bytes()==b
root=Path('/workspace/p1-complete-proof/20261125-p26-archive-v4-inputs-v1')/commit
summary=[];failed=False
for m in modules:
 log=d/('archive-v4-'+label+'-'+commit+'-'+m+'.log');assert not log.exists()
 with log.open('wb') as f:r=subprocess.run(['python3','-B',str(p),'--source-commit',commit,'--module',m,'--run'],cwd='/workspace/blue-member-build',stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 record={'module':m,'exit_code':r.returncode,'driver_log':str(log),'driver_log_sha256':hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'results':[],'audits':[]}
 for result in sorted((root/m/'runs').glob('attempt-*/RESULT.json')):
  z=json.loads(result.read_bytes());record['results'].append({'path':str(result),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(result.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'status':z['status'],'error':z.get('error'),'accepted_owners':z.get('accepted_owners'),'target_source_sha256':z['target_source_sha256']})
 for result in sorted((root/m/'audits').glob('*/lane-0/VALIDATION_RESULTS.json')):
  z=json.loads(result.read_bytes());record['audits'].append({'path':str(result),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(result.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'status':z['status'],'total_owned_exports':z.get('total_owned_exports'),'total_public_exports':z.get('total_public_exports')})
 summary.append(record);print('OWNER_RESULT',json.dumps(record,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
 if r.returncode:
  failed=True;print('FAILED_DRIVER_LOG_TAIL',log.read_bytes()[-22000:].decode(errors='replace'),flush=True);break
report={'source_commit':commit,'batch':label,'driver_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'planned_owners':modules,'completed_invocations':summary,'batch_accepted':not failed and len(summary)==len(modules),'old_v4_core_not_run':True,'archive_complete':False,'p26_complete':False}
summary_path=d/('archive-v4-'+label+'-'+commit+'-summary.json');assert not summary_path.exists();summary_path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('BATCH_SUMMARY',json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
if end==31 or failed:
 archive=d/('archive-v4-'+label+'-'+commit+'-evidence.tar.xz');assert not archive.exists();members=[]
 export_modules=all_modules[7:31] if end==31 else modules
 with tarfile.open(archive,'w:xz') as t:
  for m in export_modules:
   base=root/m
   for f in sorted(base.rglob('*')):
    if f.is_file() and not f.is_symlink() and f.suffix not in {'.olean','.ilean','.o','.so','.pyc'}:
     arc='archive-v4-remaining/'+str(f.relative_to(root));t.add(f,arcname=arc,recursive=False);members.append(arc)
  for f in sorted(d.glob('archive-v4-*-'+commit+'*.log'))+sorted(d.glob('archive-v4-*-'+commit+'-summary.json')):
   if 'first7' in f.name:continue
   arc='service-wrapper/'+f.name;t.add(f,arcname=arc,recursive=False);members.append(arc)
 data=archive.read_bytes();print('EVIDENCE_EXPORT_JSON',json.dumps({'artifact':str(archive),'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'member_count':len(members),'source_commit':commit,'base64':base64.b64encode(data).decode()},separators=(',',':')),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1 if failed else 0)
